AgentTasks.Goal: Implement a secure FIDO2 / WebAuthn "assertion / authentication" server in Rust, using the **webauthn-rs** crate for all WebAuthn-specific logic (challenge generation, assertion validation, signature verification, counter management, etc.). The server should expose two primary endpoints: 1. `POST /webauthn/assertion/options` — to initiate authentication challenge 2. `POST /webauthn/assertion/result` — to complete authentication verification Use the safe public API of webauthn-rs (not low-level core) with emphasis on security best practices. Follow FIDO Alliance conformance requirements and implement proper credential management. Execute tasks incrementally; await confirmation after each task before proceeding.

TechStack.Storage: In-memory HashMap + optional PostgreSQL/SQLite for persistence
TechStack.Security: uuid for secure identifiers, chrono for time handling

SecurityRequirements.Requirement: Proper origin validation and RPID verification
Challenge freshness and replay attack prevention
Proper error handling without information leakage

Task.Title: Configure WebAuthn Relying Party with Security Best Practices

Steps.Step: Initialize `webauthn_rs::WebauthnBuilder` with proper configuration
Set Relying Party ID (rp_id) with domain validation - must match web origin
Configure allowed origins using `url::Url` - enforce HTTPS in production
Set appropriate timeout values (30-120 seconds for assertion)
Configure user verification requirements (required/preferred/discouraged)
Set authenticator attachment preferences
Build and validate `Webauthn` instance

`start_passkey_authentication` returns `(RequestChallengeResponse, PasskeyAuthentication)`
